product_name: Handmade Brown Leather Minimalist Wallet: Mens Card Holder.

visual_observations: Compact brown leather wallet with a rectangular shape and rounded corners.
Visible snap fasteners secure the wallet when closed.
Hand stitching is visible along the wallet edges.
The wallet is shown holding cards and folded banknotes.
ai_result.long_description:
Carry your everyday essentials in this handmade brown leather minimalist wallet. Made from high-quality vegetable-tanned genuine leather and sewn entirely by hand, it is designed for convenient use in a jeans pocket or shirt pocket.

The wallet measures 2.75 × 3.93 inches (70 × 100 mm) and has 2 compartments: one for banknotes and one for up to 5 cards. Its compact design keeps essential cards and cash organized without the bulk of a traditional wallet.

A practical everyday carry accessory and a thoughtful gift for a loved one.
